title: Creole Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Creole was designed by Scott Merill, who is also known for the Seaside Honeymoon Cottages and the Seaside Chapel. This 2 bedroom cottage is on Savannah Street in Seaside, FL and steps to the beach. Creole sleeps 5 comfortably and now allows 3 night + stays
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - 2 minute walk from the Savannah pavilion Private Beach Access - You will have a total of 5 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - 2 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes - Private parking spot with an additional parking pass - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($100 fee applies at booking) Perfect for one or two couples or up to a family of five, this cottage has a living room with flat screen HDTV/Blue Ray, wood burning stove, dining area for five, internet service, fully equipped and newly renovated stainless kitchen, granite countertops, and Italian gas stove! A downstairs guest room with bunk bed (a double on the bottom and single on the top), and a bath with a shower only complete the main level. The private loft master bedroom offers a queen bed and half bath. All rooms offer Flat screen TVs throughout. The front porch has a swing with inviting Adirondack chairs for relaxation. ACCOMMODATIONS (sleeps 5) 1st floor- Bedroom 1: Bunk bed (full on bottom / twin on top). Full bath (shower only) and washer/drayer 2nd floor- Bedroom 2: Queen bedroom loft / private half bath Great location on Savannah Street with two bedrooms. Come experience a bit of N’awleans in a cozy, private cottage across from the Seaside Swim and Tennis Club and new Fitness Center. It is just a short stroll to the beach, tennis, and markets. Creole was designed by Scott Merill, who is also known for the Seaside Honeymoon Cottages and the Seaside Chapel. Seaside was on the list of Top 12 Destinations worldwide by Frommer’s 2010 and our property is part of the collection that received an 98% guest satisfaction score last season! Come and see why! * Sorry, no pets allowed ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $56/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
